symptom: The first continuity comparator required identical state_version and treated resolved pending items as lost context.
root_cause: The model initially confused continuity with immobility: it did not allow evidence-backed state evolution during interruption or explicit completion of previously pending work.
early_signals: External execution is allowed to continue while the observation channel is interrupted
A recovered task may legitimately have fewer pending items because some were completed
human_cost: No operator intervention; defect was identified before accepting the test result.
prevention_rule: Continuity must preserve checkpoint identity, objective, scope, rules, closure contract and accounting of prior pending work; state may evolve when evidence explains the transition.
automated_detection: Continuity Test 02 verifies source_checkpoint_id and requires each baseline pending item to remain pending or appear in completed_since_checkpoint_ids.
